text:
maria: Kicking off Tacoma1 GPU fleet onboarding. Drafting a compact smoke/validation flow we can run during handoff tomorrow. Please review and call out missing gates.

maria: Top-level goals: verify provisioning, network reachability (control plane + customer VPC), GPU readiness, SLO smoke (p95 gen latency < 120ms on small batch), autoscaler sanity, and cost estimate sanity.

devon: saving this. couple quick questions: what GPU SKU are we using for initial nodes? A100s or A10s?

maria: A10s to start (cost + density). We'll have a small A100 pool for heavy-ops canaries but not in initial ramp.

samir: network checklist: ensure VPC peerings established, route tables with expected prefixes, and IGW/NAT config for pull-of-models. Also confirm firewall rules allow 50051 for internal gRPC and 443 for control plane.

leo: cost note: A10 vs A100 delta ~3.5x. Recommend enabling autoscaler cooldowns and evict-policy to keep burst cost in check. I'll run a quick estimate after we decide steady-state counts.

maria: good. here's the proposed validation sequence: 1) Provision & node registration 2) GPU sanity (nvidia-smi, driver) 3) Runtime smoke: simple generation load 4) KV/prefix cache check 5) Autoscale & spike test 6) Network failover test 7) Canary rollout to 5% traffic.

devon: for GPU sanity can we use this quick check: ```kubectl exec -it inference-pod -- nvidia-smi --query-gpu=name,memory.total,utilization.gpu --format=csv``` should return at least one GPU and drivers present.

samir: add a network traceroute and egress validation to storage buckets. Example: ```curl -v https://models-internal.example.com/health || echo 'pull-fail'```

ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary job queued (job id 7421). Status: pending agents (3/5).

maria: SLO gates for the smoke run: - p95 gen latency < 120ms on 1-token prompt at 8 rps - error rate < 0.5% - tail token loss (OOB) < 0.1% during 5 min spike. If any gate fails, rollback canary and mark region as blocked.

leo: on cost estimate: I'll send a small spreadsheet but ballpark steady: 40 A10s -> ~ $X/day. Also recommend enabling bin-packing policy to reduce partial-GPU waste.

devon: on autoscaler test: plan: ramp from 5 -> 60 pods over 3 minutes, verify scale events, queueing metrics and QPS per GPU. If scale stalls for >90s per step, that's a fail.

samir: network failover: bring down peering on test route, verify requests route via alternate path and metrics show increased latency but no >10% error spike. Also validate metrics emitted to prometheus and logs forwarded to central stack.

maria: ops checklist for handoff meeting: team signoff (devon, samir, leo), canary pass, ops playbook linked, runbook PR merged, cost ack from finance.

devon: I'll own the autoscaler test and metrics dashboards. samir can do network failover. leo can do capacity/cost. maria will coordinate canary and final go/no-go.

ops-bot: incident-bot: reminder: schedule readiness review at 2026-04-02 16:00 UTC.

maria: small sample logs I expect from the runtime: ```[2026-04-02T15:12:03Z] INFO shard-3 accepted 8 requests, avg latency 98ms, tokens 320``` look for abnormal token drops or cache miss spikes.

leo: one more ask: enable request-level tracing (trace-id) for canary so we can correlate token-level regressions back to model variant.

samir: noted. also check BGP/route-origin when provisioning peering with partner datacenter — last time we saw asymmetric routing.

devon: ack. will post dashboard link once queries are live.

maria: thanks all. I'll update the handoff doc with these checkpoints and push the runbook PR. Ping me if you want to add a gate. :thumbsup:
